skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Direct DMG 120% ATK to the target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Direct DMG 150% ATK to the target's column, then applies [Damage Taken Up] 30% to all enemies (they take more DMG).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Direct DMG 150% > 225% ATK to the target's column, then applies [Damage Taken Up] 30% > 50% to all enemies.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Gains +20% HP. After any character's action, [Evolve] 2 targets that are in an [Unyielding]/[Ignore DMG] state and deals 200% ATK as Extra DMG. When battle begins, gains 60% [Instant DMG Evasion] for 2 rounds.[Evolve]: immediately cancels the target's [Unyielding] and [Ignore DMG] statuses.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: [Evolve] 3 targets; Extra DMG 200% ATK; [Instant DMG Evasion] 60% > 65%. No [Evolve] limit.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: [Evolve] 3 targets; Extra DMG 200% > 300% ATK; [Instant DMG Evasion] 65% > 70%. No [Evolve] limit.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: (Basic Effect) (1 Grappler, 1 Duelist, 1 Hi-Tech): Gain 3 energy per round.(Advance Effect) (1 Grappler, 1 Duelist, 1 Hi-Tech, 1 Esper): When battle begins, all allies obtain [Specialized Protection] of 600% original Max HP (removes damage, stackable with extra HP effects, accumulated damage removed will not be more than 15x of his original HP, can be stacked).

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Gains 1 energy once per round if any ally triggers CRIT.

skills.name: Awaken 3 Passive
skills.desc: Gains 1 energy twice per round if any ally triggers CRIT.

effects.desc: Floors that each cause a direct, additional, charge, or berserk attack to only deal 1 damage.
